question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **"followed."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Followed"** means to come after or go behind someone or something. (किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु के पीछे आना, जाना या होना)

 
 
• **Example**:* She followed__ me.*
 
 
 
• The sentence is discussing the order of events, so "preceded" (meaning to come before) would not make sense.
 
• **"Neglected"** (meaning to ignore or fail to take care of) and **"paralleled" **(meaning to be similar or equivalent to) do not fit the context of the sentence.
 
• So, the correct answer is Option 1.
 
• Correct passage:

The grammar concepts __are graded__ systematically and explained with examples __**followed**__ by exercises. The writing section ______ (3) ______ abundant practice in functional and imaginative writing with necessary scaffolding to ______ (4) ______ learners. The listening and speaking sections have activities embedded in meaningful contexts that will encourage ______ (5) ______ to interact confidently in English.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Preceded"** means to come before or go in front of. (किसी अन्‍य व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु से पहले होना, जाना या आना, पूर्ववर्ती होना (स्‍थान, समय या क्रम में))
 
• **"Neglected"** means to ignore or fail to take care of something. (किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु की उपेक्षा करना (बहुत कम ध्यान देना, बिलकुल ध्यान न देना या ख़याल न रखना))
 
• **"Paralleled"** means to be similar to or equivalent to something else. (किसी अन्य वस्तु के समान या समकक्ष होना)

The correct answer is **"provides."**
